name: Jahaziel
overview: Jahaziel was a male Levite known for a significant spiritual encounter during the reign of King Jehoshaphat. The Spirit of the Lord came upon him, marking him as a divinely inspired figure in this period. There are no additional notes on his life or character beyond this unique attribute.
namesAndTitles: The name Jahaziel means 'G-d [El] will see,' reflecting a theophoric element that emphasizes God's awareness and presence. This proper name is not indicated as given directly by God, but it carries a meaningful declaration of divine oversight.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jahaziel as the son of Zechariah. No other family relationships are noted beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jahaziel's importance arises from the Spirit of the Lord coming upon him during Jehoshaphat's reign, a moment that signifies divine intervention and guidance. His role highlights God's active presence among His people through chosen individuals. This event underscores the trustworthiness of God's Spirit to empower leaders in times of need.
